You're a strong designer with vague AI ideas… and vague doesn't ship.You've been paying attention. You've used the tools. You can see, more clearly than most engineers, where AI actually fits a real person's workflow.And yet nothing's moving. Three traps, usually:The engineer myth. "I need to get technical first." So you collect tutorials instead of making a decision.The big-idea trap. Every idea you take seriously feels like it needs a team and a roadmap. So you take none of them seriously.The model maze. SaaS? Service? Agency? You're trying to pick the perfect vehicle before you've picked the problem.The hard part of AI products is design judgment — which you already have. What you're missing isn't knowledge. It's a path.DARE is that path, walked in 90 minutes.

Everything you need to know, in ten seconds.It's $29, one-time. A working session, not a course.It's 90 minutes live on [[DATE]], [[TIME]] [[TZ]], on Zoom — with Q&A after.It's for experienced designers, design-leaning PMs, and semi-technical builders. No engineering required.You leave with one direction and a 4-week plan — a tiny agentic SaaS or an AI-powered productized service, chosen and mapped.Can't make it live? Replay included, same day, yours forever.It's the front door, not the whole house. DARE Live stands alone — and live attendees get first access when the deeper DARE program opens.

Three moves. One direction by the end.DDiscover. One buyer, one painful workflow.You already know how to find the real problem under a vague brief — you've done it in every discovery call of your career. We aim that skill at the AI landscape and cut your idea cloud down to one specific person, one workflow, one why-now. Written down.~25 minAArchitect. This is where designers win.Anyone can call an API. Almost nobody can design where the agent acts, where the human stays in control, and why anyone would trust it — that's interaction design, and it's the scarcest skill in AI products right now. You'll map your workflow into an Agent Blueprint: a simple agentic flow a real person would love to use.~35 minR+ERun + Earn. The scrappy v1, and the honest ask.We scope the smallest real version — live prototype, tiny SaaS, or repeatable service workflow — then turn it into a concrete offer with a price and the exact words to ask for money without cringing. Both land in your 4-week plan: run in weeks 1–3, earn in week 4.~30 min

John Iseghohi.Product Designer · Founder, Weekend MVPI'm a product designer. For most of my career that meant making other people's products work — until I decided to find out whether design skill alone could carry a product of its own.It could. Without becoming an engineer, I've built and shipped multiple AI-native products and agentic workflows solo — and broken down 78 more ideas in public at weekendmvp.app. Every one of them started the same way: one buyer, one workflow, one designed agentic flow.Watching other designers circle the same transition, I kept seeing the same three traps — and the same fix. Not more tutorials. A decision, made with a method. DARE is that method: the system I wish someone had handed me at the start, compressed into 90 minutes and applied to your idea, not a hypothetical one.And I'm in this for the long haul: DARE is the first of several frameworks I'm building for designers who want to become AI-native founders.[[STAT_YEARS]] yrs designing products[[STAT_SHIPPED]] AI-native products shipped soloFrameworks: DARE — more coming
